extensionDescription.message: Copy links from selected tabs in text/Markdown/HTML and open links from the clipboard in the current or new window.

showPasteMenuLabel.message: Show “Open from clipboard” in the tab menu

copyPreviewHint.message: How two copied tabs will look in the clipboard.

pasteActivateLabel.message: Switch to the first opened tab

pasteActivateDesc.message: When off, links open in background tabs and you stay on the current page.

pasteSkipDuplicatesDesc.message: If the clipboard contains the same address several times, it opens only once.

pasteSkipOpenLabel.message: Skip links that are already open

pasteSkipOpenDesc.message: Addresses that are already open in a tab are not opened again.

confirmThresholdDesc.message: Asks for confirmation when the clipboard has more links than this number. 0 – never ask.

showPasteMenuDesc.message: Turn off if you only use the extension to copy links.

confirmMessage.message: $COUNT$ links will be opened in new tabs.
